Kw Yoshi, ®at last week's manufacturing trade show I saw
some new technology that could really help improve
productivity here at the factory-by up to ten percent.
Bm Really? What is it?
w ®A smart helmet—a helmet with a screen attached
that managers can pull down to access information
and communicate with the control room. Managers
can wear the technology instead of carrying it around

m There was a budget surplus at the end of last quarter.
Kw Great. ®| could talk to the helmet's makers about a

context.transcript_translation:
男：Yoshi，在上次的制造业贸易展览会上，我看到了一些新技术，这对我们工厂提高生产力非常有帮助——最高可提高百分之十。
女：真的吗？是什么？
男：一个智能头盔——一个带有屏幕的头盔，经理可以拉下屏幕来获取信息并与控制室沟通。经理们可以佩戴这项技术而不是携带它四处走动，这样他们的手就解放了。
女：上个季度末有预算盈余。
男：太好了。我可以和这个头盔的制造商商量一下为所有人进行一次可能的演示。
女：那很好。谢谢。
